verses.text: Better is the poor who walks in his integrity than he who is perverse in his lips and is a fool.
lines: Better is the poor who walks in his integrity
than he who is perverse in his lips and is a fool.

verses.text: It isn’t good to have zeal without knowledge, nor being hasty with one’s feet and missing the way.
lines: It isn’t good to have zeal without knowledge,
nor being hasty with one’s feet and missing the way.

verses.text: The foolishness of man subverts his way; his heart rages against Yahweh.
lines: The foolishness of man subverts his way;
his heart rages against Yahweh.

verses.text: Wealth adds many friends, but the poor is separated from his friend.
lines: Wealth adds many friends,
but the poor is separated from his friend.

verses.text: A false witness shall not be unpunished. He who pours out lies shall not go free.
lines: A false witness shall not be unpunished.
He who pours out lies shall not go free.

verses.text: Many will entreat the favor of a ruler, and everyone is a friend to a man who gives gifts.
lines: Many will entreat the favor of a ruler,
and everyone is a friend to a man who gives gifts.

verses.text: All the relatives of the poor shun him: how much more do his friends avoid him! He pursues them with pleas, but they are gone.
lines: All the relatives of the poor shun him:
how much more do his friends avoid him!
He pursues them with pleas, but they are gone.

verses.text: He who gets wisdom loves his own soul. He who keeps understanding shall find good.
lines: He who gets wisdom loves his own soul.
He who keeps understanding shall find good.

verses.text: A false witness shall not be unpunished. He who utters lies shall perish.
lines: A false witness shall not be unpunished.
He who utters lies shall perish.

verses.text: Delicate living is not appropriate for a fool, much less for a servant to have rule over princes.
lines: Delicate living is not appropriate for a fool,
much less for a servant to have rule over princes.

verses.text: The discretion of a man makes him slow to anger. It is his glory to overlook an offense.
lines: The discretion of a man makes him slow to anger.
It is his glory to overlook an offense.

verses.text: The king’s wrath is like the roaring of a lion, but his favor is like dew on the grass.
lines: The king’s wrath is like the roaring of a lion,
but his favor is like dew on the grass.

verses.text: A foolish son is the calamity of his father. A wife’s quarrels are a continual dripping.
lines: A foolish son is the calamity of his father.
A wife’s quarrels are a continual dripping.

verses.text: House and riches are an inheritance from fathers, but a prudent wife is from Yahweh.
lines: House and riches are an inheritance from fathers,
but a prudent wife is from Yahweh.

verses.text: Slothfulness casts into a deep sleep. The idle soul shall suffer hunger.
lines: Slothfulness casts into a deep sleep.
The idle soul shall suffer hunger.

verses.text: He who keeps the commandment keeps his soul, but he who is contemptuous in his ways shall die.
lines: He who keeps the commandment keeps his soul,
but he who is contemptuous in his ways shall die.

verses.text: He who has pity on the poor lends to Yahweh; he will reward him.
lines: He who has pity on the poor lends to Yahweh;
he will reward him.

verses.text: Discipline your son, for there is hope; don’t be a willing party to his death.
lines: Discipline your son, for there is hope;
don’t be a willing party to his death.

verses.text: A hot-tempered man must pay the penalty, for if you rescue him, you must do it again.
lines: A hot-tempered man must pay the penalty,
for if you rescue him, you must do it again.

verses.text: Listen to counsel and receive instruction, that you may be wise in your latter end.
lines: Listen to counsel and receive instruction,
that you may be wise in your latter end.

verses.text: There are many plans in a man’s heart, but Yahweh’s counsel will prevail.
lines: There are many plans in a man’s heart,
but Yahweh’s counsel will prevail.

verses.text: That which makes a man to be desired is his kindness. A poor man is better than a liar.
lines: That which makes a man to be desired is his kindness.
A poor man is better than a liar.

verses.text: The fear of Yahweh leads to life, then contentment; he rests and will not be touched by trouble.
lines: The fear of Yahweh leads to life, then contentment;
he rests and will not be touched by trouble.

verses.text: The sluggard buries his hand in the dish; he will not so much as bring it to his mouth again.
lines: The sluggard buries his hand in the dish;
he will not so much as bring it to his mouth again.

verses.text: Flog a scoffer, and the simple will learn prudence; rebuke one who has understanding, and he will gain knowledge.
lines: Flog a scoffer, and the simple will learn prudence;
rebuke one who has understanding, and he will gain knowledge.

verses.text: He who robs his father and drives away his mother, is a son who causes shame and brings reproach.
lines: He who robs his father and drives away his mother,
is a son who causes shame and brings reproach.

verses.text: If you stop listening to instruction, my son, you will stray from the words of knowledge.
lines: If you stop listening to instruction, my son,
you will stray from the words of knowledge.

verses.text: A corrupt witness mocks justice, and the mouth of the wicked gulps down iniquity.
lines: A corrupt witness mocks justice,
and the mouth of the wicked gulps down iniquity.

verses.text: Penalties are prepared for scoffers, and beatings for the backs of fools.
lines: Penalties are prepared for scoffers,
and beatings for the backs of fools.
